WebAdmin Console Is Disabled

For security, the WebAdmin console is disabled by default.

To enable WebAdmin, create the file <server_root>/admin/conf/enable_webadmin and restart the server, for default installation:

touch /usr/local/lsws/admin/conf/enable_webadmin
/usr/local/lsws/bin/lswsctrl restart

Optionally, list the IP addresses or subnets allowed to access WebAdmin in that file. Example:

# allowed WebAdmin clients
127.0.0.1
192.168.1.0/24, 2001:db8::/64

Remove the file and restart the server to disable WebAdmin again.
